name: Kinetic
insp: brutalist kinetic type and studio portfolio sites
desc: Type is the hero. The headline falls in letter by letter and stacks; scroll and the word TAX grows until its T fills the screen and opens onto the office team in blue and green. Velocity marquees, a pinned service reel, a hover-portrait team list and a flipping tax-date board follow.
fx: Headline letters fall and stack in on load
The word TAX grows until one letter fills the screen and reveals the team photo
Tax terms and the five promises stream past and lean with your scroll speed
Services slide sideways and each card grows as it reaches the centre
Hover a name and their portrait follows your cursor
Tax dates flip in like a departures board
